generic_adapter.secret_behavior: passes SecretAccess directly to SecureProviderHttpExecutor without calling use_bytes

factory.purpose: construct generic wrappers for later exact provider definitions

invariants: Provider-specific definitions cannot read or resolve secret material.
Provider-specific definitions cannot perform DNS, TLS, socket, redirect or retry work.
The capture plan is validated before secret use or HTTP execution.
Definition, plan and request adapter codes are exact and equal.
Only SecureProviderHttpExecutor can apply credentials and execute the controlled transport.
The parser receives only ProviderHttpCapturePlan and bounded ProviderHttpResponse values.
The adapter performs no autonomous retry and no response persistence.
Production composition keeps all real provider definitions and adapters absent.
No live external request is required or claimed.
required_tests: plan immutability, redaction and adapter matching
definition protocol excludes secret and network ports
retryable/final HTTP error classification is preserved
parser receives bounded response and returns exact CapturedSource
factory constructs exact wrapper and production registries remain empty
no provider-specific names or live network dependency
excluded: RSS Atom JSON or XML parser
deployed egress SLO alert or rollback proof
